releases.title: Lanterns
releases.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

releases.title: The End of Oak Street
releases.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

releases.title: Your Name.

releases.title: Blood Sacrifice
releases.synopsis: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

releases.title: Train to Busan
releases.synopsis: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

releases.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie

releases.title: La La Land
releases.synopsis: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

releases.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
releases.synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. releases.title: Mysterious Skin
releases.synopsis: A teenage hustler and a young man obsessed with alien abductions cross paths, together discovering a horrible, liberating truth.

releases.title: Vishwanath & Sons

releases.title: The Brink of War

releases.title: Back to the 90s
releases.synopsis: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

releases.title: The Wrong Girls
releases.synopsis: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

releases.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
releases.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

releases.title: S&X
releases.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

releases.title: Wet Hot American Summer
releases.synopsis: It's the last day of Camp Firewood's season, but there's still time for the big talent show, a little romance… and for everyone to be wiped out by the piece of NASA's Skylab that's hurtling toward Earth.

releases.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
releases.synopsis: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

releases.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
releases.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

releases.title: The Rivals of Amziah King

But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

releases.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
releases.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

releases.title: All Wishes Come True!
releases.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

releases.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
releases.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

releases.title: Awarapan 2
releases.synopsis: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

releases.title: Pallaburusu
releases.synopsis: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

releases.title: Lion
releases.synopsis: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

releases.title: The Sex Slave
releases.synopsis: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.

releases.title: Disney Worldbuilders
releases.synopsis: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

releases.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
releases.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

releases.title: Take a Hike!
releases.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

releases.title: Nimrods
releases.synopsis: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

releases.title: A Beautiful Obsession
releases.synopsis: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

releases.title: People & Things

releases.title: Bigg Boss : Agnipareeksha

releases.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies

releases.title: Late Fame
releases.synopsis: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

releases.title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
releases.synopsis: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

releases.title: The Birthday Party
releases.synopsis: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

releases.title: Elijah Peel
releases.synopsis: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

releases.title: 108 Base Hospital Uri
releases.synopsis: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

releases.title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
releases.synopsis: From ordinary lives to extraordinary drama. Aspiring contestants fight to earn a spot in the Bigg Boss house.

releases.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
releases.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

releases.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
releases.synopsis: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

releases.title: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
releases.synopsis: Host Ria Ciuffo sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes, Madelyn Cline, Carlacia Grant, Jonathan Daviss, and Madison Bailey to celebrate the series' five-season run.

releases.title: He Loves Me Not

releases.title: Hushar Pittalu

When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

releases.title: The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo
releases.synopsis: Stephanie Soo dives deep into today's most explosive cases to uncover killers and predators who thought their stories would stay buried.

releases.title: Sammarth
releases.synopsis: When an unexpected turn of events shatters a young civil engineer's life, he is forced to confront his past, his beliefs, and his destiny.

releases.title: Magudam

releases.title: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan

releases.title: Sapan Verma: Lower Back Pain
releases.synopsis: Stand-up comedy special by Span Verma

releases.synopsis: This documentary delves into the history of remarkable leaders, their groundbreaking achievements, and the profound connections that have shaped football’s greatest coaching legacy.

releases.title: Madhuramee Jeevitham
releases.synopsis: Madhuramee Jeevitham is a poignant family drama that explores aging, relationships, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

releases.title: Aali
releases.synopsis: Mulla (Aali), a sound engineer near the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border, falls for Ebby Mathew, an Ayurveda doctor working in Dubai. Facing family opposition and pressure to accept other matches, she plans to elope with him. Whether he returns in time, and whether their plan succeeds, forms the story's core.

releases.title: Abijit Ganguly: Baby
releases.synopsis: Stand-up special

releases.title: World's Most Evil Women
releases.synopsis: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

releases.title: Facing El Chapo
releases.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

releases.title: Mutiny
releases.synopsis: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

releases.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
releases.synopsis: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

releases.title: The Last Sunrise
releases.synopsis: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

releases.title: The Whisper Man
releases.synopsis: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

releases.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
releases.synopsis: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

releases.title: The Early Spring
releases.synopsis: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

releases.title: All That We Never Were
releases.synopsis: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

releases.title: Yellow Mirror

releases.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
releases.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

releases.title: The Marching Band
releases.synopsis: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

releases.title: Colours of Time
releases.synopsis: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

releases.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
releases.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

releases.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
releases.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

releases.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
releases.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

releases.title: Tony
releases.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

releases.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
releases.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

releases.title: Spa Weekend
releases.synopsis: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

releases.title: Dalliance
releases.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

releases.title: Irumudi
releases.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

releases.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

releases.title: The Rivals of Amziah King

When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

releases.synopsis: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

releases.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
releases.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

releases.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

releases.synopsis: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

releases.synopsis: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

releases.title: 9/11: Reunited
releases.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

releases.title: 7 Dogs
releases.synopsis: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

releases.title: Mom Knows Best?
releases.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

releases.synopsis: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

releases.title: Late Fame
releases.synopsis: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

releases.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
releases.synopsis: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

releases.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
releases.synopsis: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

releases.title: Totally '90s House
releases.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

releases.title: Anchorage Point
releases.synopsis: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

releases.title: How to Divorce During the War

High-flying executive Marija chooses the worst possible moment for an honest conversation with her husband Vytas about divorcing - just one day before Russia’s invasion of Ukraine goes into full scale. Now they must navigate the process of separation as it collides with a refugee and mid-life crisis.

releases.title: God Is Shy
releases.synopsis: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

releases.title: Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
releases.synopsis: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez host a rewatch of films from Marvel Studios' The Infinity Saga, working their way to Avengers: Doomsday. Together, they revisit each film with a recap and a conversation about which themes and characters may continue to have future implications.

releases.title: The Last Salute
releases.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

releases.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
releases.synopsis: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

releases.title: Ram and Leela
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around a 30-year-old man whose family is searching for a suitable bride For his marriage. At the same time, he is also hoping to find true love, but nothing works out. Eventually, he meets a young woman named Leela, they fall in love, face several Unexpected challenges and twists, and finally overcome them to unite

releases.title: Judaa
releases.synopsis: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

releases.title: The Red Bag
releases.synopsis: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

releases.title: Bardaasht

releases.title: Oozhi
releases.synopsis: After two years apart, Lenin and Megha unexpectedly meet at a stargazing camp. When Lenin discovers an alien stone that takes him back into the memories and guilt of their past, he sees a chance to fix what he broke.

releases.title: Ameer Log
releases.synopsis: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

releases.title: Harrd Disk

Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.

releases.title: Spark
releases.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop—and soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to its hidden mastermind.

releases.title: Coyote vs. Acme
releases.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

releases.title: Colony
releases.synopsis: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

releases.title: The Runner
releases.synopsis: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

releases.title: The Dog Stars
releases.synopsis: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

releases.title: The Secret Woman
releases.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

releases.title: Mousetrap
releases.synopsis: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

releases.title: Just Play Dead
releases.synopsis: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

releases.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint

releases.title: Finding Emily

releases.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
releases.synopsis: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

releases.title: Clash of the Thundermans
releases.synopsis: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

releases.title: Lovesick
